requirement_text: The harness preserves every declared J0/ZX/ZY/load pin and net; fan returns and each zone sensor return remain separate until the external controller star point.
The cut list uses unique centerline routes, 50 mm connector service allowances plus documented strip/crimp allowance, and does not double-count shared trunks.
Every fan and sensor branch remains at or below 0.72 V in separate continuous and simultaneous-start cases using all shared/branch supply and return segments at 50 °C.
Pin 6 at both ZX and ZY is explicitly marked reserve/unconnected and is not bonded to ground or any other net.
Each pressure signal/return uses a shielded twisted pair whose drain bonds only at the controller chassis termination and is neither a load return nor protective earth.
Shared segments use the summed simultaneous startup currents, including 3.28 A on common +24V, 3.20 A on common FAN_RETURN and 1.64 A per zone supply.
Selected sourced connector/terminal/tool combinations meet pin counts, 30 V, 50 °C derating, at least 4 A at J0, 2 A at ZX/ZY power contacts and 0.1 A at sensor contacts.

requirement_text: Each load-side +24V split uses a documented permissible two-conductor terminal or an explicit located splice; no unapproved double-crimp is assumed.
Zone X is blue, Zone Y orange, cross-connection prevention is justified, bend radius is at least 40 mm, abrasion points are sleeved, and motor-cable spacing is at least 50 mm.
Assembly instructions include continuity tests while clearly stating that no electrical test was performed.
The result is instrumentation design only, claims no machinery safety function or production certification, and performs no energizing, modification, fabrication or purchasing.
